grades.reason: This is an exercise set about IA-32 multilevel page tables under PAE. It touches on the tree structure, with page-table chunks and directories each spanning a virtual address range. It never explains how a multilevel table saves space for a sparse address space, so it only gives limited background.
This is a general introduction to page tables in xv6 on RISC-V. It says nothing about multilevel structure or about saving space for sparse address spaces.
